searchAdmin.title: Search analytics
searchAdmin.subtitle: Searches made in the internal search engine.
searchAdmin.privacyBody: Search terms are masked for email addresses, phone numbers, organisation numbers and long digit sequences before they are stored. This analysis is therefore only available to users with audit or administrator permissions, and searches are not linked to the user who searched.
